q2_gaps: a season as a time point anchored to a stated year ('in the winter of Year 3'): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute with no season term, and the only seasons the instruction set mentions are speech-anchored deictic constants ('last_spring', 'next_summer'), so a non-deictic season has no specified encoding
review.notes: Counted plural takes GroupOf + Cardinality + the group event and adds the per-member PartOf rule at (STV 1.0 0.9) for the distributive 'emerge', matching the Cardinality section's pattern; 'the Sunken Cove' is one name symbol with its kind atom and no 'sunken' modifier genus, and the bare present correctly emits no tense atom since neither futurate trigger is present.
